verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic capture of clicks, pageviews, or form interactions. The closest items are Session Replay sampling managed from the UI without code changes, which is a different feature, and warehouse connectors, which are a different ingestion method; neither counts as event autocapture. Absent first-party evidence of autocapture, this applicable axis is judged none.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event
